name: explain-kit
description: Explain unfamiliar terms briefly or explore concepts, tools and APIs through mechanisms, examples and boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Quick term explanations and concept deep dives
interface.longDescription: Use Glossary for a compact explanation or Concept for mechanisms, positive and counter-examples, related ideas and limits. Adapt to the requested audience, language and length; verify uncertain or version-sensitive facts.
defaultPrompt: Use $explain-kit:glossary to briefly explain an unfamiliar term in Chinese.
Use $explain-kit:concept to explain a concept's mechanism, examples and boundaries.
